parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The handler command to be executed. The event data is passed to the process using STDIN. NOTE: the command attribute is only required for Pipe handlers (that is, handlers configured with type=pipe).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: The Sensu event filter (name) to use when filtering events for the handler.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: An array of Sensu event filters (names) to use when filtering events for the handler. Each array item must be a string.

parameters.name: handle_flapping
parameters.description: If events in the flapping state should be handled. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: handle_silenced
parameters.description: If events matching one or more silence entries should be handled. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: handlers
parameters.description: An array of Sensu event handlers (names) to use for events using the handler set. NOTE: the handlers attribute is only required for handler sets (that is, handlers configured with type=set).

parameters.name: mutator
parameters.description: The Sensu event mutator (name) to use to mutate event data for the handler.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A unique name for the handler. The name cannot contain special characters or spaces.

parameters.name: pipe
parameters.description: The pipe definition scope, used to configure the Sensu transport pipe. NOTE: the pipe attribute is only required for Transport handlers (that is, handlers configured with type=transport).

parameters.name: severities
parameters.description: An array of check result severities the handler handles. NOTE: event resolution bypasses this filtering. Example: [ ‘warning’, ‘critical’, ‘unknown’ ].

parameters.name: socket
parameters.description: The socket definition scope, used to configure the TCP/UDP handler socket. NOTE: the socket attribute is only required for TCP/UDP handlers (that is, handlers configured with type=tcp or type=udp).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the handler should be present or not. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The handler execution duration timeout in seconds (hard stop). Only used by pipe and tcp handler types. Default: 10

examples:
# Configure a handler that sends event data as STDIN (pipe)
- name: Configure IRC Sensu handler
  community.general.sensu_handler:
    name: "irc_handler"
    type: "pipe"
    command: "/usr/local/bin/notify-irc.sh"
    severities:
      - "ok"
      - "critical"
      - "warning"
      - "unknown"
    timeout: 15
  notify:
    - Restart sensu-client
    - Restart sensu-server

# Delete a handler
- name: Delete IRC Sensu handler
  community.general.sensu_handler:
    name: "irc_handler"
    state: "absent"

# Example of a TCP handler
- name: Configure TCP Sensu handler
  community.general.sensu_handler:
    name: "tcp_handler"
    type: "tcp"
    timeout: 30
    socket:
      host: "10.0.1.99"
      port: 4444
  register: handler
  notify:
    - Restart sensu-client
    - Restart sensu-server

- name: Secure Sensu handler configuration file
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ handler['file'] }}"
    owner: "sensu"
    group: "sensu"
    mode: "0600"

return_values.name: config
return_values.description: Effective handler configuration, when state is present. Returned: success Sample: {"command": "/usr/local/bin/notify-irc.sh", "name": "irc", "type": "pipe"}

return_values.name: file
return_values.description: Path to the handler configuration file. Returned: success Sample: "/etc/sensu/conf.d/handlers/irc.json"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the handler. Returned: success Sample: "irc"
